name: 619. A raw Gemini image body is billed at the size it names, read strictly (gemini raw image body read strictly)
description: Local fixture regression for TXE-7502, no live provider calls. Start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, start an isolated gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. The GenAI route sends an explicitly Gemini image body raw, and core never parses a raw body, so a raw image body was priced at the typed request's size or the default whatever imageSize it named. Core now prices a raw image body only through the provider's strict reading of it (schemas.RawImageBodyReader): Gemini reads generationConfig.imageConfig.imageSize and aspectRatio (or an Imagen predict's parameters.sampleImageSize) member by member, and refuses a body that names one of them twice in Google's two spellings (lowerCamelCase and snake_case), since Gemini could read the other copy than the one Bifrost prices. Red before: the body below reached Gemini and was priced at 1K. A raw body on a priced image operation of a provider without such a reader is refused raw_request_body_unsupported; that, and the size each reader bills, is pinned by Go tests in core (TestEveryProviderReadsOrRefusesRawImageBodies), since only in-process callers reach those providers in raw mode.
